title: [Performance][EPLB] Make log2phy map commits asynchronous
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Make the EPLB log2phy map commit asynchronous. Convert CPU planner maps to the destination dtype in pinned memory, then copy with `non_blocking=True` to avoid draining queued NPU work on the host.

Backport: #19366.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No API or configuration changes.

### How was this patch tested?

- `bash format.sh ci`: passed.
- Real Ascend NPU experiments verified asynchronous map copies, pinned-source lifetime, and eager/graph consumption with HCCL ordering. The validation scripts are kept outside this PR.
- Temporary NPU validation on the simplified commit: 4 checks passed. No test files are added by this PR. Full model accuracy and throughput were not measured.

- Existing CPU tests with Ascend runtime stubs: 76 passed. GitHub pre-commit, both CPU test jobs, and the CI gate passed on commit `6883ab0bd6263268f28bbdb2496146aa96348904`.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/a98247ab4db686ee03c66d5feb3c761e52a2f8ab
